title: Birbal and the Cold Water Challenge
moral: Always be fair and think wisely before judging others.

scenes.summary: Akbar announces a challenge to stand in cold water overnight.
scenes.text: One winter day, Emperor Akbar announced that anyone who stood in a cold river all night would be rewarded.
scenes.image_prompt: king announcing challenge near river in winter, cartoon style

scenes.summary: A poor man completes the challenge but is denied reward.
scenes.text: A poor man stood in the freezing river all night. The next morning, Akbar refused to reward him after hearing about the distant light.
scenes.image_prompt: poor man in cold river at night with distant light, cartoon

scenes.summary: Birbal learns about the unfair decision.
scenes.text: Birbal heard about the situation and decided to help the poor man.
scenes.image_prompt: birbal thinking seriously after hearing story, cartoon

scenes.summary: Birbal demonstrates the mistake using cooking.
scenes.text: Birbal placed a pot high above a small fire. When Akbar questioned it, Birbal compared it to the distant light.
scenes.image_prompt: pot hanging high above fire with king confused, cartoon scene

scenes.summary: Akbar realizes his mistake and rewards the man.
scenes.text: Akbar understood his mistake and rewarded the poor man. Always be fair and think wisely before judging others.
scenes.image_prompt: king rewarding poor man while birbal smiles, cheerful cartoon

story: One winter day, Emperor Akbar announced a challenge to stand in cold water all night for a reward. A poor man completed the challenge, but Akbar refused to reward him because he had looked at a distant light. Birbal later demonstrated the unfairness by placing a pot far from a fire. Akbar realized his mistake and rewarded the poor man.
